title: Unilever calls for more government action on electrification at COP31
summary: Unilever has joined the We Mean Business Coalition’s new Electric Advantage Leadership Alliance at COP31, taking place in Antalya, Türkiye, bringing together business leaders working to accelerate the shift to electrification

extraction.key_fact: 유니레버가 COP31에서 전기화 전환을 앞당기려는 기업 연합에 합류했다.
